pages.title: Neko Fur
pages.text: Neko Fur is a basic material in Neko Technology, obtained from cats. Both tamed and untamed cats will occasionally drop a Neko Fur where they stand. Neko Fur can be crafted into Neko Silk, Neko Webs, and other materials.
